results.question: how should I train my quads?
results.answer: Slow lowering, full depth, feel the thighs doing the work. Quads grow best with plenty of hard weekly work and enough food behind it. The Workout screen in the app has the details, and the Workout button under your reply opens it.

results.question: how should I train my chest?
results.answer: Train your chest with heavy weights and low reps, keeping your shoulder blades set and maintaining a steady bar path. Since it's a large muscle, focus on consistent, hard work throughout the week and make sure you're eating enough to support growth.

results.question: how should I train my quads with my knee?
results.answer: Train your quads with care for your knee. Focus on slow, controlled movements, feeling the thighs work, not the lower back. Keep reps within a pain-free range and choose knee-friendly exercises. For details, check the Workout screen in the app.

results.question: any tips for my glutes on leg day?
results.answer: Sure! For glutes on leg day, focus on squeezing hard at the top of every rep — feel the glutes working, not the lower back. Since your knee is a concern, choose movements that keep the knee quiet and avoid loading it too much. Stick to pain-free ranges and keep the weights up to build strength. Your Lower body day in the plan is a great start — check the Workout screen for details.

results.question: how should I warm up for tendonitis?
results.answer: For tendonitis, warm up your joints properly before any heavy work, and build the load gradually—tendons adapt more slowly than muscles. Isometric holds under load can also help build tendon strength. Make sure to take it easy if your tendons feel sore, and consider a physio or doctor if it persists.

results.question: what should I do for my tendons when I lift my shoulders?
results.answer: For your shoulders, focus on warm-up and controlled movements. Keep the load light and steady, and avoid any sharp pain. Let your shoulders lead the way — no pushing through pinching.
